title: QMBL: the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard
description: The best published ground-state energies for lattice models, hydrogen chains and the electron gas. Every energy carries a bound_type: variational, projected, extrapolated, approximate or exact. Each instance shows its exact energy where one exists and the best energy of each bound type; RULES.md says how they are chosen. The site qmbl.org serves the data as a JSON API, and mcp/ holds an MCP server for AI systems.
